title: 龙宫试三宝
subtitle: 合适的工具，要看用途也要看自己
origin: 《西游记》第三回（低龄温和改编补遗）

moral.zh: 选择工具不是越大越好，而要看用途、重量和是否能安全控制。
moral.en: The best tool is not always the biggest. It should fit the job, the user, and safe control.

pages.zh: 悟空来到东海龙宫，说明自己想找一件能帮助花果山的工具。
pages.en: At the Dragon Palace, Wukong explained that he sought a tool to help Flower-Fruit Mountain.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] [[DRAGON_KING]] At the turquoise Dragon Palace entrance, Wukong politely explains his purpose with open hands; no staff present.

pages.zh: 龙王先拿来一把宽大的铜扇。悟空轻轻一摇，桌上的贝壳全滚走了。
pages.en: The Dragon King first offered a broad bronze fan. One gentle wave sent the shells rolling away.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] [[DRAGON_KING]] Wukong gently tests a broad rounded bronze fan toward an empty practice lane as loose shells roll safely across a low table.

pages.zh: “风太大，不适合山里的小路。”悟空把铜扇合好，双手送回。
pages.en: “Too much wind for our mountain paths.” Wukong closed the fan and returned it with both hands.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] [[DRAGON_KING]] Wukong respectfully returns the closed bronze fan with both hands; palace attendants reset the shells, calm smiles.

pages.zh: 第二件是沉重的玉石推杆。悟空能抬起，却发现转弯时会碰到珊瑚。
pages.en: Next came a heavy jade bar. Wukong could lift it, but it was too awkward around the coral.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] [[DRAGON_KING]] Wukong carefully lifts a thick pale-jade practice bar in a wide empty area, then notices a soft coral marker would block a turn; no impact.

pages.zh: 他又把玉杆放回软垫：“能拿得动，不等于用得合适。”
pages.en: He set the jade bar back on its cushion. “Being able to lift it does not make it suitable.”
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] Wukong lowers the jade bar onto a thick padded stand using bent knees and careful hands; Dragon King nods approvingly.

pages.zh: 龙王带他来到海底宝库。最深处，一根红金柱子正发出柔和的光。
pages.en: Deep in the treasury, a red-and-gold pillar glowed with a gentle light.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] [[DRAGON_KING]] In a grand underwater treasury, a tall straight vermilion-red pillar with narrow engraved gold ends stands separately on a stone base; Wukong has not touched it.

pages.zh: 悟空没有立刻拔它，而是先量通道、看柱脚，还问清能不能试。
pages.en: Wukong did not pull at once. He measured the passage, checked the base, and asked permission to try.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] [[DRAGON_KING]] Wukong uses a plain measuring cord around the red-and-gold pillar base while asking permission; safe inspection, no pulling.

pages.zh: 龙王点头：“先想用途、再看安全，你已经找到选择宝物的第一把尺。”
pages.en: The Dragon King nodded. “Purpose and safety are the first measures for choosing any treasure.”
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] [[DRAGON_KING]] Dragon King gives a warm approving gesture beside the untouched glowing pillar as Wukong holds the coiled measuring cord.
